summary: CCH Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-10 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective July 13, 2026. The consolidation, approved by shareholders on March 4, 2026 and by the board on June 30, 2026, reduces authorized shares from 3,990,280,000 to 399,028,000 Class A and from 9,720,000 to 972,000 Class B shares, with no fractional shares issued. The action aims to maintain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price rule. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation event.
